verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management marketing claims one-click reporting on team performance with data export, and says catalog metadata enables more granular reporting. That is its own reporting capability, but the evidence never describes what the reports contain. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metrics and trend views, incident-load analytics, on-call health or burnout metrics, in-depth reporting docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I get reliability analytics — MTTA/MTTR trends, incident load, on-call health — to see whether we are actually improving

citations.quote: Robust one-click reporting on your team's performance with a flexible data export.
Attach business knowledge to all incidents for more granular reporting and escalation rules with catalog and metadata.
